chapter.p: The Lord promised Abraham that he would be blessed as well as his posterity. And you shall be a blessing unto your seed after you, that in their hands they shall bear this ministry and Priesthood unto all nations. And I will bless them through your name; for as many as receive this gospel shall be called after your name and shall be accounted your seed, and shall rise up and bless you, as unto their Father (Abraham 3:1). “The term this gospel includes not just the fullness of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, but also the fullness of the Priesthood.”1 See also FULLNESS; FULLNESS OF THE GOSPEL; FULLNESS OF THE PRIESTHOOD.
